purpose: Census explicit and structured Google Drive portrait-source coverage before any Hero portrait bulk materialization, while preserving the Stage 3 no-inference admission boundary.

censusClasses.ADMITTED_SOURCE: A canonical Hero ID is already bound to an immutable source file ID and passed the Stage 2/3 source admission requirements.
censusClasses.STRUCTURED_FOLDER_CANDIDATE: A direct Hero-like child folder exists under an approved rarity root, but no authoritative Hero ID to Drive folder/file bridge has been proven. It is not admitted.
censusClasses.NO_STRUCTURED_FOLDER_COVERAGE: The Drive rarity-tree folder population is numerically smaller than the canonical Hero population for that rarity, so this hierarchy cannot cover all canonical Heroes even under an ideal one-to-one bridge.

admissionRules: Hero ID remains the only portrait ownership key.
A Drive Hero-folder title must not be converted into Hero ID ownership by name equality, translation, alias, or fuzzy similarity.
A filename or basename must not be converted into Hero ID ownership by similarity.
Presence under a folder titled 기본 is source-family evidence only; it is not sufficient to select a PNG.
Do not select the first, newest, largest, shortest-named, or only apparent portrait PNG in a 기본 folder without an explicit selection bridge.
Locale or variant siblings such as *_CH.png must not be silently preferred or discarded by filename inference.
The five Stage 2 immutable Drive file IDs remain admitted because their Hero ID ownership and file bytes were separately proven.
No source file is copied to public/images/heroes/cards during Stage 4-0.
completionCondition: Freeze parent-ID-based Drive folder counts, 5-of-5 Stage 2 hierarchy continuity, the structured-tree population gap, and a bulk-readiness verdict without promoting unanchored folder or filename evidence into canonical Hero ownership.
nextOnIncompleteCoverage: Prove an explicit Hero ID to structured Drive folder/file bridge for candidate folders without using name-only ownership inference.
Prove another authoritative source family or Unity prefab dependency-resolution path for canonical Heroes not covered by the structured Drive tree.
Only after combined explicit admission reaches 267/267 may bulk PNG materialization begin.
